notes.title: Sandbox Beta Release
notes.content:
[h1][b]Oval Racer Series – Sandbox Beta Release[/b][/h1]

First off, a big thank you to everyone for your patience and support. I know I've missed deadlines and haven't been super active on Discord, but I've been hard at work, and I'm excited to share the first major update for the game! There’s plenty more to come in future updates, with the goal of releasing new features every month (fingers crossed!).
The game has undergone a complete overhaul, shifting into a "Sandbox" style experience. This means a lot more work on my end, but for you, there will be so much more to do beyond just racing! Here’s what you can expect in this update:
________________________________________
[b]Open Track Experience[/b]
You’ve heard of “Open World” games, but with this release, we’re introducing an "Open Track" experience! Feel free to explore the track and discover any bugs or areas that need fixing. Your feedback is essential as we refine the game.
This update marks the new starting point for all future updates!
________________________________________
[b]Key Features in This Beta[/b]
1. Move to Unreal Engine 5
•	The entire game has been rewritten from scratch, with the exception of a few plugins.
2. New, More Detailed Models
•	Improved visual fidelity with highly detailed models.
3. Interactive Menu
•	You can now walk around in the main menu, making the experience more immersive from the get-go.
4. Weather & Time of Day System
•	A dynamic weather system and real-time day/night are now in place. Lights will automatically turn on at night, adding more realism.
________________________________________
[b]Track Update: Standlake Arena[/b]
I’m testing out a new track: Standlake Arena. It’s a very high-poly, highly detailed track, which may be overkill, but I wanted to stress-test it with your help! Don’t worry, you can adjust graphic settings in the menu if it’s too demanding on your system. You can also open and close the gate on the track for a more authentic oval racing experience.
________________________________________
[b]Skins[/b]
I've temporarily removed custom skins from the game, leaving only blank colors and a "novice" skin for now. More updates are coming soon!
________________________________________
[b]Modding Support[/b]
Good news: modding is coming! The first step is allowing custom skins, so you’ll be able to create your own skins and share them on the Steam Workshop. The tool for this is almost ready—just need to fix a small issue (rain runs up the car on one side and down on the other—whoops!). Once that’s sorted in the next few weeks, I’ll release the app so you can start uploading your custom skins.
________________________________________
[b]Let’s Get Racing![/b]
Now it's your turn to dive in and explore the update. I can’t wait to hear your thoughts! Time for me to get back to work on the next big update.

notes.title: Ai Update!
notes.content:
Welcome to the first major update for Stoxkarts.

This update sees the very first work in progress ai racers into the game, we have 8 ai racers skins and 10 ai racers on the starting grid, You do not have to race with the AI if you don't want to, you select the check box on the track selection screen to race with them as seen in the image below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843405/b6432dd4d63227d091dd695bae2e9c146a76e0fa.png[/img]

I have also done a fix for the in-kart glitch so now you can race from cockpit view!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843405/91ead840cbcaae5010a597deb775de9cbdcc3420.png[/img]

Check out these first simple AI skins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843405/c2f66e8b742548832d2db8381fe42685539708fc.png[/img]

If you have not already, add the game to your wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683630/Oval_Racer_Series__Stoxkarts/

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843405/53e56d1680f133515854b577bc336f847d5282cc.png[/img]

Welcome to the first release for Oval Games, We bring to you the first in a series of oval racing games, Oval Racer Series – Stoxkarts! (ORSS).

This release will have basic functions that can be seen below but so much more to come each and every month! There will be Weekly News and Monthly updates.

If you have not already, add the game to your wishlist: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683630/Oval_Racer_Series__Stoxkarts/

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*] Single Race
[*] Garage
[*] Skin/Paint Selection
[*] Track Selection
[*] Basic Profile
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843405/27d3227e61ffe2ce403bb522ccf21d399c9bbf0a.jpg[/img]

[b]Single Race[/b]

Selection from a number (EA Release 2) of tracks that you can race laps or race against the WIP (Work In Progress) AI racers, Select your own time of day and even select the weather of choice for that day, More weather physics will be added into the game as each update comes out.

[b]Garage[/b]

At the EA Release, there will just be Front Left and Front Right Camber settings that you can adjust, -10 – +10. This is auto-saved into the game so there is no need to go back and change it each time you race. I may pout up a poll to see if you want different setups for each track or if you are good with changing it for each track.

[b]Skin/Paint Selection[/b]

You can select from a number of paint jobs that is in the game, I am planning to make a FREE DLC for just paint jobs to make things easier to update in the future and even a possible steam workshop mode so you can paint your own skins and share them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843405/12a5be952907c57b4b5a4a7155e39d99a5ac0403.png[/img]

This is a very basic profile on the EA Release, you can just edit your name (I may change that to a choice of Nickname or steam name in a future update) and shows you the skin/paint with the name of the real driver, more features like a number of races won, next Championship race etc will be added as time goes on.
